counterparty: Mirvac Funds Management Australia Limited, as trustee of Mirvac Wholesale Office Fund I
description: On 9 May 2024, Keppel REIT completed a DPU-accretive acquisition of a 50% interest in 255 George Street, a freehold Grade A office building in the core precinct of Sydney's CBD, for a headline A$363.8 million, through Keppel REIT (Australia) Sub-Trust 8. The remaining 50% interest is held by the seller, Mirvac Funds Management Australia Limited, as trustee of Mirvac Wholesale Office Fund I.
note: purchase_price S$320,835k is the audited total purchase consideration from the cash-flow Note A (p125): investment property S$318,367k + financial asset at FVTPL S$2,468k. Note 3 (p139) states the consideration as approximately S$320,981k; the property portfolio review (p38) and Financial Review (p60) give the headline A$363.8 million. Independent valuation by CIVAS (NSW) Pty Limited of the 50% interest was A$363.8m with rent guarantee (A$358.9m without), as at 1 March 2024 assuming legal completion 1 June 2024 (p38 fn1). No FY2024 disposals disclosed.
gain_on_divestment_basis: n/a - acquisition (50% interest purchase), no gain/loss on divestment disclosed. Independent acquisition valuation by CIVAS (NSW) Pty Limited concluded market value of the 50% interest as at 1 March 2024 (assuming legal completion 1 June 2024) of A$363.8m (with rent guarantee) / A$358.9m (without); total purchase consideration S$320,835k. Audited FYE valuation S$323,363k (as at 31 Dec 2024). No divestment gain/loss applicable; not derived.
